workspace.title: Negotiation workspace
workspace.description: Review the current commercial position and permitted next steps.

offers.title: Offer history
offers.description: Submitted terms are preserved as an immutable commercial record.
offers.emptyDescription: The supplier has not submitted a commercial offer for this Deal.

privacy.title: Protected participant context
privacy.description: Only information already authorized by the Deal and its source request is shown. Contact details remain protected.

counter.title: Create offer version {{number}}
counter.description: Propose revised commercial terms. The server will verify that it is your turn before adding a new immutable version.
counter.historyNotice: The previous offer stays visible in the negotiation record.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.currency: Enter a valid three-letter currency code.
errors.validity: Choose a future validity date and time.

accept.title: Accept this offer?
accept.description: Acceptance locks this exact Offer Version and moves the Deal to Agreed. It does not create a Booking.
accept.competitors: Every other actionable offer for this Deal will be rejected automatically in the same atomic operation.

reject.title: Reject this offer?
reject.description: The offer will remain visible in the history as rejected and cannot be reopened in this workflow.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this offer?
withdraw.description: The submitted terms will remain in the Deal history, but the Agency will no longer be able to accept them.

expire.title: Mark this offer as expired?
expire.description: This action confirms that the server-authoritative validity time has passed.

cancel.title: Cancel this Deal?
cancel.description: The Deal will close without agreement and all submitted offers will be rejected atomically.

close.title: Close this agreed Deal?
close.description: This records the Deal as closed. It does not create or change a Booking.

feedback.accept: Offer accepted and Deal moved to Agreed.
feedback.counter: Counteroffer submitted as a new immutable version.

errors.backend_unavailable: The Deal workspace is not enabled in this environment.
errors.network: The network connection was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.permission: This action is no longer available for your account.
errors.stale: The Deal changed while you were reviewing it. The latest state has been loaded.
errors.state_changed: This action is no longer valid. The latest Deal state has been loaded.
errors.unknown: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

unavailable.title: Deal unavailable
unavailable.description: This Deal does not exist or is not available to your active organization.

backend_unavailable.title: Negotiation workspace is not enabled
backend_unavailable.description: This environment does not yet provide the V3 Deal workspace. Existing GroupToStay workflows remain available.

network.title: Connection interrupted
network.description: We could not load the latest Deal state. Check your connection and try again.

permission.title: Deal unavailable
permission.description: This Deal is not available to your active organization.

stale.title: Deal updated
stale.description: The commercial state changed. Refresh to review the latest information.

state_changed.title: Action no longer available
state_changed.description: The Deal changed before this action completed. Refresh to continue.

unknown.title: Unable to load Deal
unknown.description: The workspace could not be loaded safely. Please try again.
